evidence.summary: Discovery is deterministic and explicit by default.

reproduction.instructions: Run mncs-test discover with and without --recursive; the default is the explicit root manifest plus direct tests/*.toml, while recursive traversal is opt-in and sorted.

summary: mncs-test cannot make recursive filesystem discovery a native operation, so normal execution uses explicit manifests and direct test entries.

workaround.description: The runner requires an explicit manifest for run; sorted os.walk/rglob is only used by opt-in discovery/provenance adapter code.
